Let \(r=\frac{x}{y}\). From \(x^2+xy+y^2=0\), we get
\[
r=\frac{-1\pm i\sqrt3}{2}=e^{\pm 2\pi i/3}.
\]
Then
\[
\frac{x}{x+y}=\frac{r}{r+1}
=\frac{e^{\pm 2\pi i/3}}{1+e^{\pm 2\pi i/3}}
=e^{\pm i\pi/3},
\]
and therefore
\[
\frac{y}{x+y}=1-e^{\pm i\pi/3}=e^{\mp i\pi/3}.
\]
Thus the expression is
\[
\left(e^{\pm i\pi/3}\right)^{1990}+\left(e^{\mp i\pi/3}\right)^{1990}
=2\cos\frac{1990\pi}{3}.
\]
Since
\[
\frac{1990\pi}{3}=663\pi+\frac{\pi}{3},
\]
we have
\[
2\cos\left(\pi+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)=2\left(-\frac12\right)=-1.
\]
\[
\boxed{-1}
\]
